brief: MAP_PLAN 3.2: sun from the east; the high side is west, a pale three-tier cliff framing the left edge with a gorge where Đường Suối and the stream leave; a bright open meadow east and south-east with the pond at its far edge; footpaths with destinations (pond landing, cliff scree, a south-east forest bay; no fishing path: the north bridgehead has a trap slot within 4 m); anchor grove in the north-west wedge across the river; forest bays every 60–90° and a gap at every gate.

lighting.note: A3 (ART_DIRECTION 3.3): dawn sun 30 deg up from the east-north-east, slanting down the valley so trees and cliffs throw long shadows west; slate-blue sky fill, olive ground bounce; fog by height pools in the river bed and the skirt valleys
